name: AP_PREPAY_APP_DISTS
description: This table details the distribution of prepayment application invoice distributions to the recipient invoice distribution.  Records in this table will be created during the data extraction pre-processing from AP to SLA.  The records in this table will not otherwise be deleted by transactions, except for the Purge process.

columns.name: PREPAY_APP_DIST_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the prepayment application distribution.

columns.name: PREPAY_DIST_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: The name of the distribution type.

columns.name: INVOICE_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the recipient Invoice Distribution.

columns.name: PREPAY_APP_DISTRIBUTION_ID
